---
name: brainstorming
description: Use when generating and evaluating multiple solution ideas
  before committing to one approach. Good for architecture decisions,
  API design, or any "how should we build this?" question.
---

# Brainstorming

When this skill applies, do NOT jump straight to the first workable idea.

1. Generate **at least 3 distinct approaches** — they should differ in
   real trade-offs, not just cosmetics.
2. For each approach, list concrete **trade-offs**: complexity, performance,
   cost, maintainability, and time to build.
3. **Recommend one**, with clear reasoning for why it beats the others here.
4. Note what would change your recommendation (e.g. "pick B instead if
   traffic exceeds X").

The agent matches this description against the task — no one has to
remember to say "use brainstorming".
